title: E-Commerce Platform
description: A complete shopping experience built around a product catalog, a persistent cart, and a guided checkout. It models the everyday retail flow end to end, from discovery through order confirmation and history, all served by a mock API.
impact: End-to-end e-commerce storefront covering catalog discovery, cart management, guided checkout, order tracking, and wishlist flows across mobile and desktop platforms.
responsibilities: Built a product catalog with categories, search, and detail pages.
Implemented a persistent cart with quantity and variant handling.
Developed a multi-step checkout flow from address entry through payment, review, and confirmation.
Added order history with per-order status tracking.
Implemented wishlist and favorites for saved items.
Delivered responsive layouts across phone, desktop, and web targets.
achievements: Delivered a full retail journey from product discovery through order confirmation and history.
Shipped cross-platform experiences for iOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Backed the storefront with a mock API serving catalog, cart, checkout, and order workflows.
